distinguishing_features: Pressure-energized fluid film at the seat interface instead of static material/geometry hardening
Use of a hydrogen-impermeable low-viscosity fluid drawn from line pressure to fill surface-roughness valleys
Self-scaling barrier where film pressure tracks line pressure, relaxing local stress intensity factor KI
Passive hydrodynamic squeeze-film sealing mechanism requiring no external actuation or new sensors
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to block Fickian hydrogen permeation paths and reduce crack-initiating stress concentrators at a high-pressure valve seat without changing the mechanical load class or adding active hardware.
parsed.viable_reason: As written it is not physically sound: an incompressible liquid film cannot sustain P_interface > P_line to give zero net driving force, low-viscosity PFPE/silicone fluids are not demonstrably H2-impermeable and would be exuded/depleted under 70 MPa cycling, and the seal is not a positive barrier since the fluid has no source pressure head above line pressure; the pass criteria also cannot establish the claimed mechanism.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Introducing a pressure-energized liquid squeeze film to both block permeation and reduce seat stress is not a routine parameter change from any of the cited arts, which concern chemistry dosing, dP monitoring, or current indexing.
